coordinates.note: CAST is housed in an SPS-fed experimental hall (historically referred to as SR8/West Area) on CERN's Prevessin site. No fetched source this session gives a precise SR8 building coordinate, so the CERN Prevessin campus point (OpenStreetMap/Nominatim) is used as an approximate fallback, per the wave-3 brief's explicit guidance for CAST ('a sourced point or CERN campus approximate'). This is a deliberately coarse (~3 km precision) campus-level placeholder, not a detector-precision coordinate.

summary.plain: An experimental hall fed by CERN's SPS accelerator, on the French side of the CERN site, where the CAST experiment searched for axions from the Sun until the end of 2022.
summary.technical: SPS North/West Area experimental hall (SR8) on CERN's Prevessin site, housing the CAST decommissioned-LHC-test-dipole helioscope from 2003 to 2022.
